text:
Maya: Heads-up — planning a small "sneak peek" roundtable + benchmark reveal. Target: Thu 9AM PT (NA/EU) + Thu 9AM SGT (APAC). Need final subject, RSVP gating, routing logic, and suppressions.
Jon: Cohorts: trial-30d, newsletter-open-30d, docs-downloaders. Docs-downloaders = high-intent, treat as priority.
Priya: RSVP form fields: name, email, company, role, company_size, primary_reason (benchmark/cost/ops), demo_interest (yes/no). Hidden utm: utm_campaign=sneakpeek_roundtable, utm_medium=email, cohort={cohort}.
Zoe: Subject line tests: A) "Sneak peek: our inference benchmark + roundtable" B) "How teams cut inference cost — live panel"  we'll test subject + preheader for engaged-newsletter; docs-downloaders get a bespoke variant with company personalization.
Maya: Suppress list: attended/RSVP'd in last 60 days, unsubscribed, hard bounces. Dedupe across cohorts (highest intent wins).
Jon: Routing pseudo-rule: if (role =~ /(Head|Director|CTO|PM|ML)/ || company_size >= 500) -> owner = "sdr-enterprise"; else if (cohort == "trial") -> owner = "sdr-trial"; else owner = "sdr-nurture".
Priya: For docs-downloaders with previous demo clicks -> mark lead_score=high and show "book demo" in confirmation flow.
Zoe: Send timing: NA/EU gets 9AM PT send; APAC gets separate send at 9AM SGT with localized time mention. Keep downloaders out of subject A/B.
Maya: CTA flow: RSVP -> thank-you page with calendar add + conditional "book a demo" (only for owner==sdr-enterprise or lead_score==high).
Jon: Add small survey on RSVP: "primary reason for attending" helps route post-event follow-up.
Priya: Ops question: webhook -> CRM mapping for utm, cohort, role, lead_score? ops-bot: deploy queued Wed 19:00 PT to wire form -> CRM staging. Please QA mapping in staging.
Zoe: Creative notes: hero chart snapshot, 2 bullets (latency, cost per token), speaker panel, 20min demo + 10min Q&A.
Maya: Owners: Priya (form + UTMs), Jon (segmentation & routing), Zoe (copy + creatives), ops-bot (deploy). We'll do a 15m pre-send check Wed 3PM PT.
ops-bot: Reminder: webhook deploy job scheduled -> marketing/forms -> staging (Wed 19:00 PT).
Priya: I'll drop segments CSV to /marketing/seg-exports/sneakpeek by EOD and mark APAC timezone recipients for staggered send.
Jon: Also add suppression: exclude anyone who opened the last benchmark email in 7 days to avoid fatigue.
Zoe: I'll post final copy + three subject variants to #copy-review in 90m.
Maya: Sweet — ping here when staging mapping is validated and we'll greenlight the send. :white_check_mark:
